rows.quote: IRWIN W. KRESSER, JR. May 1971 June 1981 "Ike" began as our Maintenance Mechanic on May 18, 1971, a newly created position. He has served the school system well and has left his mark on us with the craftsmanship of his efforts in the schools and offices. On June 23, 1981, "Ike" chose to begin a well-earned retirement. We all will (and have) missed his presence and talent.

rows.quote: LAURIER P. LETARTE April 1971 May 1981 Laurie began as a custodian at the Lunenburg Jr.-Sr. High School on April 5, 1971. On July 5, 1977 he transferred to the Turkey Hill Middle School as senior custodian. He applied for and received the appointment to transfer to the Elementary Annex on July 6, 1978, He retired from this position on May 20, 1981 after ten years of faithful service. - 62
